skills.title: Creator Interview
skills.purpose: Elicit a concrete job, audience, outcome, criteria, and boundaries without asking the creator to write prompts.

skills.title: Example Decomposition
skills.purpose: Separate observable evidence from taste in labeled good and bad examples.

skills.title: Decision Rule Extraction
skills.purpose: Turn creator explanations into scoped rules, exceptions, and quality checks.

skills.title: Workflow Graph Authoring
skills.purpose: Compile typed, bounded workflow nodes and conditional edges.

skills.title: Rubric and Eval Authoring
skills.purpose: Convert definitions of done and failure modes into executable evaluation cases.

skills.title: Feedback Attribution
skills.purpose: Attribute explicit feedback to a project exception, graph node, skill, or rubric.

skills.title: Skill Change Proposal
skills.purpose: Create the smallest evidence-backed candidate patch without modifying the active revision.

skills.title: Candidate Comparison
skills.purpose: Compare candidate and baseline revisions with validation and regression gates.

skills.title: Release Readiness
skills.purpose: Require current validation, tests, evals, and creator approval before promotion.

skills.title: Brief Interpretation
skills.purpose: Normalize communication objective, audience, channel, deliverables, constraints, and assumptions.

skills.title: Asset and Brand Evidence
skills.purpose: Extract brand rules with source evidence and distinguish explicit rules from observed patterns.

skills.title: Concept Divergence
skills.purpose: Generate strategically distinct directions instead of cosmetic variants.

skills.title: Visual Hierarchy and Layout
skills.purpose: Organize attention, grouping, rhythm, and responsive composition around the communication goal.

skills.title: Typography and Legibility
skills.purpose: Select and evaluate type roles, scale, spacing, density, and reading conditions.

skills.title: Color and Accessibility
skills.purpose: Use color as hierarchy and state while checking contrast and non-color cues.

skills.title: Design Quality Critique
skills.purpose: Evaluate an artifact independently against the normalized brief and observable gates.

skills.title: Revision Planning
skills.purpose: Translate feedback into localized, prioritized changes without erasing successful decisions.

skills.title: Delivery Specification
skills.purpose: Verify formats, dimensions, naming, provenance, and editable-source expectations before delivery.
